title: Exact initial-wall map and the missing one-promotion chamber
mathematical_status: partial coverage theorem plus smallest bounded actual gap

canonical_target_map.definition: Write uniquely n=binom(q,2)+r and n+b-1=binom(q+c,2)+u with 0<=r<q and 0<=u<q+c.
canonical_target_map.parity_and_range: The remainder ranges are canonical by construction. The actual dyadic definition gives 2h=binom(b-1,2)+2-n, so the relaxed parity, h>=224, and b<h conditions hold identically.
canonical_target_map.x_condition: x>=0 is exactly the source no-borrow antecedent, not an added relaxed hypothesis.
canonical_target_map.surplus_identity: The actual next diagonal surplus equals U_3(y)-U_3(x)-z-1, exactly the relaxed gamma4.
canonical_target_map.promotion_lower_bound: Actual states always have c>=1. Since integer h>b gives n<=binom(b-1,2)-2b=binom(b-3,2)-5, the leading index q of n satisfies q<=b-4. Hence adding b-1 crosses at least the next triangular cap.

source_to_target_cases.status: closed for sufficiently large h with exact finite bases as stated in the inherited files
closed by rank three when q_borrow>=2 and by rank four on the q_borrow=1 boundary
exactly mapped; gamma4 equals the next actual surplus. Eventual positivity is uniform in c, but an effective/explicit finite completion below its existential Q is still absent.
not exhausted by the inherited six observed transition types
source_to_target_cases.exact_relations: Writing b=q+k gives u=r+k-1. The first rank-two tail normalization and the next raw rank-three tails determine a sign transition. Five inherited types have proved rank-five positivity; (--)->(++) can be rank-five negative but has a proved rank-six repair only on one explicit family. The actual (++ )->(++ ) type below was absent from the old finite atlas and has no all-parameter chamber theorem.

smallest_new_actual_chamber_in_complete_.scope: All actual dyadic states on strips 2<=j<=6 were enumerated in increasing (j,b); this is the first (++ )->(++ ) row with gamma3<0 and gamma4<0.
smallest_new_actual_chamber_in_complete_.force: This is an actual dyadic Macaulay transition, not an abstract completion. It refutes use of the old six-row observed atlas as an exhaustive one-promotion case partition. It does not refute adaptive seeding because gamma5 is positive.

bounded_case_census.interpretation: Finite data support a one-promotion two-row recovery, but are not an unbounded proof.

refined_exact_next_lemma.name: One-promotion two-row recovery with complete chamber exhaustion
refined_exact_next_lemma.statement: For every actual dyadic no-borrow state with canonical promotion count c=1, gamma3<0, x>=0, and gamma4<0, the exact normalized transition belongs to a proved chamber and max(gamma5,gamma6)>=0. The proof must include the newly observed (++ )->(++ ) chamber and a universal treatment of the (--)->(++) chamber, not merely the existing counterfamily.
refined_exact_next_lemma.additional_completion: For c>=2, make the existential uniform threshold Q effective or prove the finitely many q<Q actual states positive without assuming a numerical value of Q.
refined_exact_next_lemma.closure_effect: Together with the already closed initial borrow chambers, exact c>=2 mapping, uniform relaxed positivity, and suffix persistence, this would establish actual-orbit coverage and the rank-42 seed gate.
